title: Image with a caption that fits the frame
summary: max-width: 100% and aspect-ratio keep an image responsive, and object-fit crops it instead of squashing it.
explanation: width: 100% makes the image as wide as its frame. aspect-ratio: 4 / 3 then sets its height from that width, so the frame has a stable shape before the picture loads and the caption below never jumps.
object-fit: cover fills the frame and crops the overflow, so the subject is not stretched. max-width: 100% on the caption stops long text pushing the frame wider than its container.
tryThis: Change object-fit to contain: the whole image shows, with empty bands at the sides.
Remove aspect-ratio: the image falls back to its natural height and the frame changes shape.
Set aspect-ratio to 1 / 1 for a square crop.

children.text: A caption that wraps onto more lines when the frame is narrow.
